step.instructions: Full setup starts its own normal run and reads the wave digits, upgrade labels and Ultimate Weapon names. If Intro Sprint is visible, it opens the prompt and ends the sprint; setup does not change cards to make it appear. Otherwise you start or continue a normal battle and the scan only watches. For digits, use the wave counter; for valuefont, use the value display. Capture each literal character separately at native size. Never touch a tournament run.

notes.battle_actions: POST /api/operations/{id}/actions (live-controls shares the route function: one accepted live-controls sample is included). The admitted-then-failed samples are injected exactly as test_dashboard_admission.py injects them.
notes.battles: Battle bodies come from the real BattleSession over the real GemWatch and Shopper collectors, launched through the real POST /api/control start (no frames, no input). Controls move through the driver's own checkpoint; an action's started/completed/failed/rejected progress is the driver's acknowledgement call, made directly because collecting a gem needs frames. The orbit collector's last_outcome is the dictionary its own loop builds. GET /api/battles/active never changes the ledger: closing the record of a driver that is gone is the refresher (_harvest_tick) and nothing here touches a game on screen.
notes.format: Each case is {request:{method, path, body?}, status, body}. A JSON body is the route's exact answer (keys sorted by Flask); a body that is not JSON (the default 500 page an unhandled exception produces in production, exception propagation off) is {text}. Ids are aliased in order of appearance; the scenario root is <root>; time is the fixed clock 1800000000 (2027-01-15 08:00 UTC).
notes.runs: The list of images a run needs is replaced per case (so a case names its rows); the readiness check, the files it looks for, the rows' cards and the /api/runs projection are real. Module restoration, the setup_required variants (validation errors from the real profile validator) and the combo entry (a profile plan) are real. readiness_check_raised injects the exception.
notes.status: GET /api/status, one sample per condition: every root member except harvest (its own fixture, harvest_status_v1.json) and runtime (the build and port identity of the machine; /api/runtime is not a Dashboard contract). The process table, adb server and emulator port are in-memory stand-ins under the real scan, projection and adbclient parser; the two no_server samples differ only in the injected exception (a refused connect and a timed-out connect), their bodies are identical.
notes.unknown_outcomes: control_unknown_outcomes and write_unknown_outcomes: requests that had an effect before the answer failed, each with the follow-up read or identical-key retry the route offers; the harvest writes (harvest_outcome_unknown, input_revocation_failed) are in harvest_status_v1.json. start_accepted_with_transfer repeats the harvest fixture's transfer sample because 10.3 lists it for POST /api/control.
notes.wizard_state: GET /api/wizard/state returns the file the wizard writes. after_scan is the section the real emulator scan saved; all_sections adds adopt and resolution through the same writer (_wiz_save) with the payload shapes their routes write (adopting needs a config rewrite and the resolution probe a screencap, neither of which belongs in this generator).
